title: reader::AuthConfig::is_dev_mode omits client_certs and trusted_issuers
description: reader::config::AuthConfig::is_dev_mode() checks required, users, credential_file, oidc_providers but NOT client_certs or trusted_issuers. stoa_auth::AuthConfig::is_dev_mode() checks all six fields. An operator who configures [auth] with only client_certs (no users, no credential_file) gets is_dev_mode()==true, causing AUTHINFO credential checks to be bypassed in lifecycle.rs and main.rs. Fix: add && self.client_certs.is_empty() && self.trusted_issuers.is_empty() to the reader's is_dev_mode body, matching stoa_auth.
